scan.scope: whole .text direct loads of exact outer global; straight-line same-basic-block alias propagation until first call/branch/return

limits: This closes only aliases created before the first control-flow/call boundary after a direct exact-global load.
Aliases created across branches, by callees, through returned pointers, or through interface/subobject reconstruction remain open.
Subobject derivations such as outer+4, outer+0x780, outer+0xc4c are not treated as exact outer aliases.
No identity is inferred from matching offsets.
next_step: Trace cross-block/callee-created exact outer aliases and returned-pointer reconstruction; continue runtime-derived HDVehicle+0x4330 aliases.
